title: Faceted filter panel
description: A filter panel for narrowing listings by several attributes: grouped facets with counts, multi-select checkboxes, ranges, and toggles; a row of active-filter chips with one-click removal and a clear-all; and counts that update to show the effect before or after applying.
intent: Let users narrow a large set by several attributes and always see and undo what is applied.
characteristics: facet groups as fieldsets with legends and result counts
active filter chips above results with remove buttons
clear-all action visible when any filter is active
long facets show top values with a show-more control
range facets accept typed values, not only sliders
interaction: Desktop applies immediately; mobile sheet batches changes with an Apply button that shows the resulting count; filters live in the URL; zero-count options are disabled or hidden consistently.
responsive: Side panel on wide screens; full-height sheet behind a "Filters (3)" button on narrow screens.
accessibility: Checkboxes and radios with native semantics inside fieldsets; chips are buttons named "Remove filter: Blue"; result count changes announced politely; sheet is a modal dialog.
limitations: Counts per facet need backend support.
Too many facets overwhelm; order by usage and collapse the rest.
